title: Constraint: Knight's Tour (3 × 4)
constraints: Find an open knight's tour on a 3 × 4 board (3 rows, 4 columns): a sequence of 12 squares (`r[k]`, `c[k]`) visiting every square exactly once, each step a legal knight move. Different calls should find different tours.
Runs on Verilator with the z3 solver (`sudo pacman -S z3`).
hints: Represent each step by its row and column. "Every square exactly once" means all 12 (r, c) pairs are different.
A knight move changes one coordinate by ±1 and the other by ±2. `inside {-1, 1}` on signed differences expresses it neatly.
Tours on larger boards (5 × 5, 8 × 8) are too hard for the solver interface in reasonable time. 3 × 4 is the smallest board that has one.
